testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/voucher-history-validate-pagination-and-sorting.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Voucher History > validate pagination and sorting

scenario.summary: The signed-in my-account user opens Voucher History, checks heading, columns and Actions column, the total number of vouchers on one page (both arrows disabled), sorting by name, number, start date, expiration date, transaction amount and remaining amount (first row asc/desc), then opens one voucher (name link) and sorts its transactions by order number. Read only.
steps: Signed in through the shared storageState; open Voucher History; heading, column headers, Actions column
Page size largePageSize: rows equal footer total; total equals totalVouchers; prev and next disabled (single page)
Sort by VoucherName, VoucherNumber, StartDate, ExpirationDate, TransactionAmount, RemainingAmount: first row asc / desc equals the recorded anchors
Voucher link of viewVoucherId shows voucherName; view it; sort transactions by OrderNumber; at least one transaction, ascending
stateChanges: None: the account's vouchers are only read
assertions: Rows equal footer total; total equals totalVouchers; both arrows disabled
First row of each column sort asc/desc
Voucher name link text; transactions sorted by order number (non-empty)
evidence: DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts AUTH_SPECS = my-account/**), signed in through the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts. That setup signs in with getMyAccountUser() (testim-migrated/src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, whose username is requireEnv('MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME') (testim-migrated/src/config/env.ts:80; process.env, then .env.<env>, then .env). Source 0 records that credential (masked; kind properties = environment variable). On migration the test declares it before reading any owned record: await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username) - the same value the setup signed in with, so the declared account is the signed-in one. No spec data file holds it

LEASE NOTE: every webstore-auth spec shares this one account; declaring it leases the account per test (useExisting waits while another test holds it), so migrated my-account specs run one at a time on it (protects counts from parallel runtime carts, but lengthens the phase that must finish inside the storageState session's 1-hour token)
Title 'validate pagination and sorting'; MAINTENANCE NOTE (last run failed on 'single page: prev disabled', not triaged) recorded as evidence only

OWNERSHIP: Voucher History lists the vouchers whose ZnodeGiftCard.UserId is the signed-in account (read-only tda rows: the spec's two vouchers share one UserId and the store MaxwellsHardware, PortalId 7; IQ2UMBUJ9B is RestrictToCustomerAccount true, active, expires 2031, balance left; 1KPV2W1Y9Z is NOT restricted but still carries the account's UserId). Need voucher = VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER with owner @user.userId (gc.UserId = @owner): resolves at useExisting; strategy migrate

viewVoucherId -> voucher.voucherNumber, voucherName -> voucher.name (data): the voucher opened must have at least one transaction (same gap as the details spec: proposed VOUCHER_OF_USER_WITH_TRANSACTIONS)

DATA SHAPE: the account owns 2..64 vouchers (any restriction, the list shows every ZnodeGiftCard with its UserId) so each sort has distinct first rows, all on one page. No key expresses the account's voucher set: VOUCHER_UNRESTRICTED / VOUCHER_FOR_ALL_USERS take no owner

MISSING KEY (proposed VOUCHER_HISTORY_OF_USER, entity voucher, read-only, aggregate over the account's vouchers on the store): params owner (@user.userId), store, minVouchers, maxVouchers; outputs voucherCount, and first-row anchors per sort (nameAscendingFirst/DescendingFirst, numberAscendingFirst/DescendingFirst, startDateAscendingFirst/DescendingFirst, expirationDateAscendingFirst/DescendingFirst, amountAscendingFirst/DescendingFirst, remainingAscendingFirst/DescendingFirst). Would supply totalVouchers and the 12 anchors; until then they are expected-output (remaining amounts are balances of the account's vouchers, not personal data; expiration dates are masked by the scanner)
Column header text, page size and sort column ids are config / expected-output
Not profiled: no profile observation exists for this test

Re-mapped to new keys (2026-11-01): voucherHistory = VOUCHER_HISTORY_OF_USER (owner @user.userId, minVouchers 2, maxVouchers 64 = largePageSize with both arrows disabled, store): totalVouchers -> voucherCount; the 12 sort anchors -> firstNameAsc/Desc, firstNumberAsc/Desc, firstStartDateAsc/Desc, firstExpirationDateAsc/Desc, firstAmountAsc/Desc (Transaction Amount column), firstRemainingAsc/Desc (checked against the pending query). voucher (VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER) still supplies viewVoucherId/voucherName; this test reads no voucher dates through it. Strategy migrate
